<source id="1" name="Flyagainla tone guide">Patterns for Imitation:
- Headers: Urgent, price-forward, slangy (e.g., "平飛大減!...二千五有找!").
- Short Comments: Exclamatory openers (e.g., "平到喊!").
- Summaries: 2-4 sentences on perks/attractions + CTA with ~.
- RAG Use: Feed to AI for generating JSON output with "Destination", "Header", "Short Comment", "Summary". Index by tags (Staycation, ANA) for retrieval.

## Sample JSON Outputs for RAG
Use these as templates: Parse for slang, structure; generate JSON with ONLY Destination, Header, Short Comment, Summary.

### Sample 1: Tokyo ANA Package (Flight + Hotel)
{
  "Destination": "東京",
  "Header": "坐ANA早去晚返!東京7日6夜套票,包ANA來回機票+6晚住宿,每位連稅$4,132起!11月至2026年8月指定日子出發",
  "Short Comment": "ANA例牌又減,循例睇下套票幾錢啦~",
  "Summary": "東京$4,132起連機票同酒店,平到你唔信!想去新宿逛街同食壽司,呢個價錢真係超值,立即book啦~"
}</source>
<source id="1" name="Flyagainla tone guide">## RAG Generation Guidelines
- For JSON Output: Array of objects with ONLY "Destination" (e.g., "東京"), "Header" (full title), "Short Comment" (hook), "Summary" (結論 text). No other fields. Group similar (e.g., "九州" for multi-Japan) if input specifies.
- Input Parsing: From bracketed data (e.g., [航空公司:...]), extract Destination, price, airline, dates, etc. Assume HK$ prices, "連稅", defaults (e.g., Trip.com, 2025/2026 for dates).
- Imitation Tips: Headers use "平飛大減"、"早鳥優惠"; Short Comments use "嘩!"、"平到喊"; Summaries mention local attractions (e.g., 東京=壽司, 熊本=熊本熊). Use ~, !, 20-30% slang.
- Retrieval Hooks: Query by "ANA", "Staycation", "CLS" for samples. Output valid JSON (quotes, commas).</source>
